ideas.title: Investigating the MyGender Dolls program
ideas.description: This story would investigate the MyGender Dolls program and the federal investigation into it. It would explore the program's activities and the reasons behind the federal investigation.
questions: What is the MyGender Dolls program?
ideas.insight: I believe that the MyGender Dolls program investigation may be connected to a larger scheme, potentially involving fraud or misuse of funds. Further research is needed to uncover the truth.
